Rule 1: "Months: days 1-30 are month 1, days 31-60 are month 2. Each meter's month-to-date (MTD) usage resets to 0 when its first reading of month 2 arrives."

Usually month-to-date resets at month boundary, so before billing the new month's usage is 0.
